summary: Risk-on tape is holding into midday (indexes up roughly 1.5-2% as oil slides on Iran peace hopes) while Nvidia stays down about 5% on the Huang board probe. Since the last update the list is unchanged: Nvidia's breakdown moved to its true opening low near $170.24, and confidences were trimmed slightly for less time left; live quote pages were blocked, so prices are estimates from news reports.

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: Up about 10% on the Oppenheimer upgrade ($600 target) and Google Cloud EPYC win; a clean break of $500 targets $510.

picks.name: Amazon
picks.reason: Up about 5% on JPMorgan's focus list (AWS growth above 40%) with the index rally holding; above $270 keeps $275-279 in play.

picks.name: Meta Platforms
picks.reason: Up about 5% after JPMorgan added it to its focus list; a break of the 644.54 intraday high extends it.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Down about 5% on the board probe of CEO Huang and lagging the chip rally; losing the 170.24 opening low resumes the slide.

picks.name: Eli Lilly
picks.reason: Up about 2% after Jefferies set a street-high $1,700 target on ex-US GLP-1 demand; a break of $1,400 extends it.

picks.name: DraftKings
picks.reason: Triple downgrade after Friday's 21% guidance-cut drop, but the strong risk-on tape is capping follow-through.
